title: The Wood Cultivator's Companion
summary: A companion for those past the courses that adds the felling weight of timber and a bark guard that grows back as it breaks.

title: A Treatise on the Grown Guard
summary: A treatise on guards of knotted bark and ironwood that hold the line and return thorns for blows.

title: The Canon of Living Timber
summary: A canon of mending and raising that treats the body as living timber and can bring a stilled breath back.

title: A Treatise on the Great Root Network
summary: A treatise on spreading qi roots through the ground to sense far steps and share strength between allies.

title: The Twin Bough Course
summary: A school course in paired limbs of qi that strike and guard together and close on a twin crash.

title: Treatise of the Basin Tree and River Root
tradition: basin tree and river root school
summary: A school treatise that gathers qi like water in a basin tree and sends it down the river root to heal or flood.

title: Manual of the Hawk-Perch Elm
summary: A school manual of the elm that the hawk perches on and the plunge that follows from its highest limb.

title: The Wind-Sworn Wood Course
summary: A school course in pines sworn to bend with the wind and never break and the lashes they return.

title: Manual of the Plateau Oath Tree
summary: A school manual of the lone tree that stands in the open on its oath and roots to the rock.

title: Treatise of the Bearing Pine Unbroken
summary: A school treatise on a pine that holds its bearing against any gale and strikes on the same line.
